# Terrace Sun

> Free web tool that tells you when direct sunlight reaches the walls and outdoor tables of a café (or any spot) on a chosen date.

- Input: a café name (geocoded with Nominatim), coordinates, or a Google Maps link, plus a date.
- Method: building footprints and heights from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API) within 250 m; a 2.5D ray is traced towards the sun every 5 minutes for sample points along each street-facing wall (1.5 m high) and 2.5 m in front of it (table height, 1 m).
- Output: sun time ranges and hours per wall, a shadow map with a time slider, and monthly totals on the 21st of each month.
- Limits: direct beam only, clear sky, flat ground, no trees or awnings; untagged building heights are estimated and adjustable.
- One page; the "Checking a" dropdown switches between café terrace, hotel, holiday rental, roof for solar, wedding/event spot and public space (URL param mode=hotel|host|solar|wedding|city). /rome-sunny-cafes/ is a ranked list and map for Testaccio, San Saba, Garbatella.
- Shareable URL format: https://terrace-sun.netlify.app/?lat=41.87726&lon=12.47359&date=2026-09-10&name=Cafe
- Real estate mode: for the building at the pin, shows direct sun hours on the windows of each floor (ground to top) per street-facing wall, with a copyable listing sentence.
- /listings/: Sun Score badge and branded sun-exposure report for property listings; JSON API at GET /api/v1/sun?lat&lon&floor&floors&key. Plans: Free (5 reports/month), Agent EUR 19/month, Agency EUR 79/month, Portal API EUR 390/month.
- /report/?lat&lon&floor&floors&name&agency&logo&agent: the report document (Sun Score A to E, seasons, facades, floors, monthly, shadow map, method).
